title: Point diagram realization data
statement: For finite-field datum D with geometric point s = Spec k, prime l different from its characteristic, a finite extension E of Q_l, and an algebraic closure Omega of Q_l, define omega_E = H^0 of the specified rational point fibre, T_E the actual geometric-Frobenius pullback and t_E = H^0 of its specified point transport. A diagram realization consists of a heart-valued diagram G with natural isomorphisms theta: G T_E ≅ G and eta: G omega_E ≅ V and isomorphisms t_i: omega_E G_i ≅ omega_E T_E G_i. Exact realization means reflection of parallel-arrow equations, monomorphisms, short exact sequences and cokernel universal properties. Point realization additionally specifies the forward and inverse Weil-map fibre formulas and the conjugated local Frobenius equality. Finite scalar realization extends G along the recorded scalar extension using exactly the normalized pullback/scalar and fibre/H^0 comparisons, including its transport square. Common-stage realization includes the diagram at its original finite stage using the recorded Shrink and tensor-tower comparisons and requires the analogous exactness, transport and Frobenius equations. All constructions and predicates are the unchanged definitions extracted from lem-zl-point-equivariant-diagram-lift.
